styles.name: Sonoran Native
styles.tagline: The desert, as it grows here.
styles.description: Palo verde shade, golden barrel and brittlebush in warm decomposed granite. Native plants, natural drifts, almost no upkeep once established.
styles.materials: warm tan decomposed granite, a few natural weathered boulders, a gentle dry wash of river rock
styles.plantsPrompt: a small palo verde tree, golden barrel cactus, brittlebush, desert marigold, desert spoon and a prickly pear

styles.name: Modern Desert
styles.description: Sculptural agaves and red yucca, large boulders, gray granite and steel edging. Architectural and calm.
styles.materials: gray crushed granite, large smooth boulders, clean steel edging, a few square concrete pavers
styles.plantsPrompt: large sculptural agaves, red yucca (hesperaloe) in neat rows, desert spoon, golden barrel cactus and one multi-trunk desert tree

styles.name: Pollinator Garden
styles.tagline: Color for you, food for bees.
styles.description: Penstemon, globe mallow, desert marigold and salvias that bloom across the seasons and feed bees, butterflies and hummingbirds.
styles.materials: warm decomposed granite with a curving flagstone path and a few small boulders
styles.plantsPrompt: flowering penstemon, orange globe mallow, yellow desert marigold, purple salvia, blooming Texas sage shrubs and a desert willow tree
